mapper.sql: m.id, m.dept_id, m.name, m.description, m.sort_no, m.status, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.deleted, d.dept_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM practice_subject s WHERE s.module_id = m.id AND s.deleted = 0) AS subject_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam e WHERE e.module_id = m.id AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.exam_mode = 'PRACTICE' AND e.exam_type = 'THEORY') AS exam_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM practice_module m LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = m.dept_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO practice_module (dept_id, name, description, sort_no, status, create_by, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{sortNo}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update:

name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW()
